violations.text: Upper/lower reach-in unit was observed held at 44 degrees Fahrenheit. Butter observed with a temperature of 44 degrees F. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Lower door of this unit observed to be open and was not able to be completely closed. Service call placed and were on-site during inspection. Foods had been placed in this unit less than 4 hours before inspection and were moved to the walk-in cooler. No TCS foods are to be stored in this unit until it is maintaining a consistent temperature at/below 41 degrees F. New Violation. Correct By: 11/23/2026

Upper/lower reach-in unit is not in good repair. Lower door is not closing. Dishwasher observed in poor repair and is not currently sanitizing. 3-bay sink is being used to wash, rinse, and sanitize. 3-bay sink must continue to be used until dishwasher is repaired and is reaching proper sanitizing concentration. Warewashing handsink is in poor repair and is not currently being used. Handsink being used is in close proximity to warewashing area. Warewashing handsink must be repaired. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2026

Quaternary ammonium sanitizer solution was in excess of 400 parts per million (ppm). A quaternary ammonia sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be applied at the strength as indicated on the manufacturers' label (200 - 300 ppm). Water was added to the sanitizer bay and reached proper concentration. Service call placed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2025

Both the handsink and the dishwasher located in the warewashing area are not in good repair and are not currently being used. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/26/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the dispenser units near the drive thru have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. These areas must be cleaned. New Violation. Correct By: 11/26/2025

Upper/lower reach-in at the counter was observed held at 45 degrees Fahrenheit. No foods observed in this unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Temperature setting was adjusted during inspection, but temperature did not reach 41 degrees F. Service call is to be placed. No TCS foods are to be stored in this unit until it is maintaining a consistent temperature at/below 41 degrees F. New Violation. Correct By: 11/25/2024

Lock mechanism (inside handle) of the walk-in cooler is not in good repair. Tape observed over the lock. Maintenance on-site to correct this issue. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/02/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine and some equipment at the drive-thru area have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact areas must remain clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/25/2024
